messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kas ma võin korraks
kurta,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}?

{07 0f 00}Ma pole suutnud püüda
{04 1a 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 0b 00}Huvitav...kui ma kastaksin
sööda {04 13 00} sisse,
kas see aitaks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I've been so busy fishing
that I haven't been working
out like I should{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}I wish there was a machine
that would let me train 
while fishing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma olen nii kalapüügiga
hõivatud olnud, et pole
teinud trenni nagu peaks{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}Ma soovin, et oleks masin,
mis laseks mul treenida 
kala püüdes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}My muscles are at total
peak pumpitude today,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 11 00}I bet I could use my bare
hands to catch myself
{04 1a 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mu lihased on täna täiesti
tipphoos,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 11 00}Vean kihla, et suudaksin
paljaste kätega püüda
{04 1a 00}!

messages.en:
I've been looking for a
good place to catch
{04 1a 00}...
{07 06 00}But I've been walking around
so much that my glutes are
sore, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Ma olen otsinud head kohta,
kus püüda
{04 1a 00}...
{07 06 00}Aga ma olen nii palju ringi
kõndinud, et mu tuharad
valutavad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
It doesn't really matter
whether or not I catch
{04 1a 00}...
{07 14 00}I'm just enjoying spending
time chatting with my
buddy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Pole eriti tähtis, kas ma
püüan või ei püüa
{04 1a 00}...
{07 14 00}Ma lihtsalt naudin aja
veetmist oma semuga,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00}
I've been catching nothing 
but garbage!
{07 0b 00}Do you think this is some
kind of sign?{02 00 00 08 09}
Yeah, maybe. 
No way!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00}
ma olen püüdnud ainult 
prügi!
{07 0b 00}Kas sa arvad, et see on
mingi märk?{02 00 00 08 09}
Jah, äkki. 
Ei mingil juhul!

messages.en:
I've found my calling.
{07 1b 00}I should ditch the weights
and become a fisherman!
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}Naw,{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm just yankin'
on your chain a bit!{01 01 00}
{07 03 00}War har har har!
messages.et:
Ma leidsin oma kutsumuse.
{07 1b 00}Ma peaksin raskused jätma
ja kaluriks hakkama!
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}Ei,{01 00 00 0a 00} ma lihtsalt
tõmban sind haneks!{01 01 00}
{07 03 00}Vaar haar haar!

messages.en:
{07 1d 00}Yo{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}ho ho!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0d 00}At least SOMEBODY 
appreciates my talents!
{07 16 00}Garbage can be even more
difficult to catch than
fish, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}Jou{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}hoo hoo!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0d 00}Vähemalt KEEGI 
hindab mu andeid!
{07 16 00}Prügi püüdmine võib olla
veel raskem kui kala
püüdmine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}What?! What's your beef?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
I'm saving the rivers and
oceans from that garbage{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 15 00}Look, you're still young. 
You'll understand someday,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Mida?! Mis sul viga on?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Ma päästan jõgesid ja
ookeane selle prügi eest{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 15 00}Kuule, sa oled veel noor. 
Kunagi sa mõistad,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
